controls.label: DORA Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT)

measured.classification: ICT third-party service provider (not a DORA-identified significant financial entity)

controls.detail: TLPT not mandatory for current entity classification (documented determination). CyberForge: ICT third-party service provider (not a DORA-identified significant financial entity). Rationale: CyberForge is an ICT third-party service provider and has not been identified by any competent authority as a financial entity significant for TLPT purposes under DORA Art. 26(8). The mandatory triennial TLPT obligation (DORA Art. 26-27, RTS 2025/1190) therefore does not currently apply. This determination is reviewed whenever the entity's classification or a client contractual requirement changes; should the entity become in scope, in_scope is set to true and a real TLPT engagement is recorded under `tlpt` before this control can pass.
